entries.title: Exact-version reviewed hypotheses and scoped source-linked references
entries.summary: Adds bounded neutral knowledge contracts, injected transactional reference services and explicit route/UI seams without mounting shared application paths or changing any acceptance status.
added: Exact source hash/Unicode-offset support and immutable version/digest-bound review, terminal retirement, scoped lexical search and history.
Registerable API and isolated graphite review/search component with explicit context/API adapters; existing starter drafts remain unvalidated hypotheses.
changed: Runtime inventory validation and exact configured-weight digest/size/details allowlists; unreachable/ambiguous remains unknown, not false.
fixed: New reference versions cannot inherit prior review; changed or withdrawn source access cannot be recovered through idempotent replay.
verification: Final source-tree pytest: 1427 passed, 0 failed/errors/skips, one Starlette/AnyIO deprecation warning. Final changed service/runtime/UI focus: 71 passed, including six Node/fake-DOM component tests.
Python compilation, all browser JavaScript syntax, schema export and structural plan-review bench 8/8 passed.

Final native runner 20261025T233752Z-c6a9eb2a: overall FAILED. 379 checks in 11 native suites passed; Studio assertion failed. Source unchanged during run; source SHA-256 75f3bcec64c6dc76bd7b9de8b71ec19486188160148f6004f1c8715451b04f97. Earlier failed run retained separately; final adapter/capacity hardening rerun without changing any shared gate.
Installed-wheel regressions FAILED: frozen package allowlist omits endstate.intelligence. Base-aware changelog FAILED pending central fragment merge. Existing generated-register checks passed.
limitations: At receipt creation this branch's changes were local; exact committed/pushed head is returned separately after remote verification. No merge, PR change, release or deployment.
Shared routing, current identity/vault/source eligibility adapters, schema migration, navigation and package manifest remain integration-owned and unmodified.
New component has six Node/fake-DOM checks, not native UI/human accessibility acceptance. Current native suites cover existing-app preservation only.
No model download/inference, professional approval, held-out semantic evaluation, pilot/value measurement, production tenant/retention security approval or optional runtime work.
Journal quotes remain at rest after withdrawal; output denial is not secure erasure. Search is bounded lexical case/matter-scoped reference lookup, not semantic learning or outcome proof.

discoveries: EM-233: Reference review must identify exact content without becoming fact or action authority.
EM-234: Withdrawal denial and terminal retirement need different source-access rules.
EM-235: A model inventory listing is not a loaded or quality-approved model.
EM-236: Nested engine contracts require an explicit distribution declaration as well as source tests.
EM-237: Inspectable precedent can increase review burden without proving operator benefit.
EM-238: Native shipping-state assertions can fail independently of functional app preservation.
risks: Source support is not truth or expertise; replay/review cannot revive revoked permission.
Incomplete package declaration, missing transactional policy adapters and uncertain-write retries can undermine a source-tree-only claim.
Review burden may exceed value; local quote retention is not managed deletion.
architecture_implications: Keep ENDSTATE contracts free of service imports; identity/source storage/API policy stay injected in 8BALL.
Central integration must explicitly include the nested package and scoped route/UI/policy adapters, merge register fragments and run exact-tree acceptance.
emergence_review.roadmap_decision: Existing-task engineering and explicit integration requests only. No new required task, acceptance promotion, optional-hold implementation or release permission. EM-237 remains an unmeasured operator hypothesis; owner review of all six findings is pending.
